# xdemorse

**Live Morse decoder with a GTK waterfall, from a sound card**

- **Version recorded:** 3.6.7
- **Categories:** `cw`
- **Upstream:** <https://www.qsl.net/5b4az/pkg/morse/xdemorse/xdemorse.html>

## What it does

Listens on a sound card, shows a narrow spectrum display so you can see which tone you are decoding, and prints the Morse it hears as text. It tracks sending speed automatically within a range you set.

## Why you would want it

It is the small, focused live decoder: a window with a waterfall and a text pane, no logging, no modem, no configuration ceremony. When the question is just "what is that signal saying", fldigi is a lot of program to start.

## Before it will work

Receiver audio reaching a sound-card input — a physical cable, or a loopback device if the receiver is itself software. Set the audio device inside the program, not by hoping the default is right.

## Install and launch

- **Installed with the profiles:** [`listening`](../profiles/listening.md), [`morse`](../profiles/morse.md).
- **Install:** `hammunition install xdemorse --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `xdemorse`

## Known problems

Hand-sent Morse with irregular weighting defeats it, as it defeats every automatic decoder; the operator's ear remains better and this is worth knowing before blaming the software. It decodes one tone at a time, so a crowded band needs the receiver's filter narrowed rather than the program adjusted.
